data.name: Symmetry Group Limited
data.description: Symmetry Group Limited ('the Company') was incorporated in Pakistan as a private limited company on 3 February 2012 under the repealed Companies Ordinance, 1984 (now Companies Act 2017). In May 2017, the Company was converted to a public limited company. The Company listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange on September 01, 2023. The principal activities of the Company are digital media and advertising services encompassing transformation, interactive, commerce and mobility activities.
